description: Defines abstract classes and interfaces for managing index buffers in Direct3D rendering within the ANGLE project, including classes IndexBuffer, IndexBufferInterface, StreamingIndexBufferInterface, and StaticIndexBufferInterface.

classes.name: IndexBuffer
classes.description: Abstract class for index buffer operations, including initialization, mapping, unmapping, and size management.

classes.name: IndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Interface for managing index buffer memory, including reservation, mapping, and buffer size management.

classes.name: StreamingIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for streaming index buffer management.

classes.name: StaticIndexBufferInterface
classes.description: Derived class for static index buffer management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index buffer with given context, size, type, and dynamic flag.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the buffer memory for access.

methods.name: getIndexType
methods.description: Returns the type of indices stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the buffer.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size and type of the buffer.

methods.name: reserveBufferSpace
methods.description: Reserves space in the buffer for new data.
